spans.s:
Consonants unseparated by a vowel are called conjunct consonants.

Terms:

And after a root ending in a consonant and preceded by a vowel of the प्रत्यहार इक् , the affix सन् beginning witha झल् consonant, is like कित् ।

Terms: कित्

In उपदेश , the final consonant of roots etc. is इत्।

Terms: इत्

The affix शानच् is the substitute of श्ना after a root ending with a consonant, when हि follows.

Terms: शानच्

The affix ष्ट्रन् is used after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of instrument when denoting a member of the body of a plough or of a hog.

Terms: ष्ट्रन्

And after a verb ending in a consonant, comes the affix घञ् (when the word to be formed is masculine and related to the verb as an instrument or a location and thereby the palatal is changed into guttural).

Terms: घञ्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words 1. हल and 2. सीर।

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'what bears it' after the words 1. हल and 2. सीर in Accusative -2nd case construction.

Terms: ठक्

After a consonant there is the elision of the nominative affix स् and the tense-affix ति and सि (when reduced to the form of त् and स् ) being consonants; and so also after the long vowels ई and आ of the feminine (affix ङी and आप् ), there is the elision of the nominative affix स्।

Terms:

The Locative -7th case ending is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ when the compound is a Name.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

The long vowel is substituted for a vocalised half-vowel अ , इ and उ at the end of a अङ्ग (stem), when it is preceded by a consonant which is a portion of the stem.

Terms: Lengthening

The य् of a तद्धित affix when preceded by a consonant and penultimate in a अङ्ग (stem), is elided before the feminine ई।

Terms: य elision

The इद् of इदम् is elided before a विभक्ति affix beginning with a consonant.

Terms: सर्वनाम इदम्

Of the consonants of the reduplicate, only the first is retained, the remainders are elided.

Terms: Reduplicate

Of a root ending in र् or व् , the penultimate इ or उ is lengthened before a consonantal beginning affix.

Terms: penultimate lengthening

(The य् when preceded by 1. भो 2. भगो 3. अघो 4. अ or 5. आ , is elided) before a consonant according to the opinion of all आचार्रचा-s.

Terms: व् and य् elision

The कृत् affix, coming after a verb, which begins with a consonant and has a penultimate इच् vowel, changes optionally its न् , which is preceded by a vowel, into ण् , when it comes after उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-कृत्-उपसर्ग

After a consonant, the following semi-vowel or a nasal is elided optionally, when the same letters follow it
